channel.title: TotalMarket
channel.description: Indian markets, IPOs, tech and AI news, explained

item.title: Critical PHP flaws found with AI help force emergency patches; OpenAI models come to Google Cloud
item.description: Finland briefly shut some government web services; separately, Google Cloud customers will be able to buy OpenAI models and Codex.

item.title: Adani Energy Solutions Q2: profit ₹1,364 crore, up 145%, helped by a ₹1,581 crore tax write-back
item.description: Revenue rose 53% to ₹10,076 crore, but the operating margin narrowed about 4 percentage points.

item.title: Evening markets: Nasdaq slides about 2% on AI jitters; Brent above $111 after Aramco attack; gold slips
item.description: Meta fell about 5% despite beating forecasts, Tesla cut its 2026 spending plan, and European shares opened lower.

item.title: IPO today (22 Oct): Jio 5.51x after day 2, Fusion CX lists at 5.5% premium, four listings Friday
item.description: Your daily IPO class: what's open, what listed, what's coming, and what 'shareholder quota' means.

item.title: Q2 results: Havells profit up 9.7%, Swiggy loss narrows to ₹922 crore, HPCL earns ₹3,625 crore
item.description: Colgate's profit rose 4.3%; HPCL's profit fell 6.1% from a year ago but it swung back from a large first-quarter loss.

item.title: Stock market today: Sensex sheds 460 pts, Nifty 22,687.65 as oil jumps to $112; media, FMCG, IT drag
item.description: A third straight fall as Brent jumped about 3% after attacks on Saudi Aramco; two shares fell for every one that rose, and FIIs sold about ₹3,459 crore.

item.title: Sensex falls 460 pts to 73,249, Nifty ends at 22,687.65; third straight loss as oil, West Asia weigh
item.description: IT, FMCG and media led the fall; M&M Financial sank nearly 10% after results while Indian Hotels rose. Brent jumped to about $112.

item.title: Sensex down 471 pts, Nifty at 22,636 by noon as West Asia tension and oil weigh
item.description: Chemicals, autos and metals led losses; mid and small caps fell about 1% as the rupee slipped to 94.50.

item.title: Fusion CX lists at ₹305 on NSE, 5.5% above its ₹289 IPO price
item.description: The ₹702 crore IPO was 3.03 times subscribed; shares eased slightly after the open.

item.title: Jio IPO day 2: 4.3x subscribed, retail portion fully booked; Paras Healthcare at 0.21x
item.description: Institutions bid 9.6 times their quota by midday; one day left for both IPOs.

item.title: Adani Green Q2: profit ₹747 crore, down 24% from last quarter; shares fall for 5th day
item.description: Profit rose 16% from a year ago, but lower grid availability and slower capacity additions hurt the quarter.

item.title: Overnight: Nasdaq +1.05% on AI rally; Meta up, Tesla down after hours; GIFT Nifty signals weak start
item.description: Wall Street rose for a fourth day, but GIFT Nifty points lower as oil stays above $108 and Indian broader markets stay fragile.

item.title: Meta and Tesla results: Meta revenue beats at $64.6 billion; Tesla profit falls 43%
item.description: Meta raised its AI spending range again; Tesla's sales were flat as battery supply limited output.

item.title: Gold rate today: 24K falls to about ₹1,46,070 per 10 g, silver near ₹2.3 lakh/kg
item.description: Shop rates eased overnight as a firmer rupee made imported gold cheaper; global prices were steady.

item.title: Stock market today: weak start signalled; HPCL, Havells, Swiggy results; Fusion CX lists
item.description: GIFT Nifty is 0.37% lower; Jio and Paras IPOs enter day two and five companies report results.

item.title: Eternal Q2 results: profit up 92% to ₹125 crore, revenue jumps 78% as Blinkit grows
item.description: Zomato's parent beat its low base on quick commerce; Blinkit now has 2,751 stores and targets 3,500 by March 2027.

item.title: Evening markets: Europe firmer, US opens higher before Meta and Tesla results; oil eases on Iran talk
item.description: Brent slipped back from $111 after Iran's foreign minister signalled openness to diplomacy; gold held near $4,140.

item.title: Stock market today: Nifty ends at 22,811 after 450-point swing; smallcaps sink 2.37%, IT jumps 2.9%
item.description: An 800-point Sensex rally faded into a second straight loss as oil near $110 and broad selling hit mid and small caps; IT was the only sector in the green.

item.title: IPO today (21 Oct): Jio 3.04x on day 1, Paras Healthcare 0.15x, HD Fire lists at 24% premium
item.description: Your daily IPO class: what's open, what listed, what's coming, and one concept explained simply.

item.title: Sensex ends 143 pts lower, Nifty 22,811; smallcaps sink 2.37%, IT the only gainer
item.description: An 800-point morning rally turned into a second straight loss as the broader market sold off and volatility jumped.

item.title: Jio IPO day 1: 2.38x subscribed by 3 pm; QIBs bid 7x, retail at 0.61x
item.description: Bids for about 47 crore shares came in on the first day of India's biggest IPO.

item.title: Rupee hits six-week high of 94.49 on Jio IPO inflows and RBI steps
item.description: The currency has recovered more than 2% from near-record lows earlier this month.

item.title: Sensex gives up 800-point jump; Nifty slips to 22,824 at noon as IT gains, midcaps wobble
item.description: An early rally faded as the Jio IPO drew cash and volatility rose; IT stocks held up while Bajaj Finance and Eicher weighed.

item.title: Jio IPO subscription day 1: fully booked in 35 minutes, 1.31x by noon; retail at 0.25x
item.description: Big institutions rushed in first; retail and HNI investors have two more days to bid.

item.title: Rupee jumps 29 paise to 94.62 as Jio IPO money and RBI support lift it
item.description: Foreign money coming in for India's biggest IPO helped the rupee, even with Brent above $110.

item.title: MCX gold slips to ₹1,45,972, silver falls 1% as Brent climbs to $110
item.description: Higher oil revives inflation worries and keeps US rate-hike fears alive, pressuring precious metals.

item.title: Eternal Q2 results today: brokerages expect profit to jump on Blinkit growth
item.description: Zomato's parent reports after market hours; quick-commerce growth and margins are the numbers to watch.

item.title: Overnight: Dow jumps 530 pts, oil eases off $110, GIFT Nifty points to firm start
item.description: A rotation into healthcare and value stocks lifted the Dow to a record-style rally while tech stood still; lower oil and yields calmed nerves.

item.title: Gold rate today: 24K near ₹1.47–1.49 lakh, silver around ₹2.3 lakh/kg
item.description: Global gold slipped as US yields stayed above 5%, but Indian shop rates edged up after the Dussehra break.

item.title: Crude oil: Brent tops $110 for a moment, settles at $108.79 as Hormuz risk lingers
item.description: Oil hit a five-month high on tanker attacks before easing, and it was rising again in early Asian trade.

item.title: Rupee at 94.92 as FIIs pull ₹49,900 crore from Indian shares in October
item.description: A softer dollar overnight helps, but steady foreign selling and costly oil keep the rupee near 95.

item.title: Kospi crashes 3.73% as AI chip worries hit Samsung, SK hynix; rebound under way
item.description: South Korea's market fell about 21% in seven sessions before this week; foreign and institutional funds sold again on Tuesday.

item.title: Stock market today: Jio IPO opens, Eternal and Adani Green results, Nifty 22,800 in focus
item.description: Markets reopen after Dussehra with a positive GIFT Nifty, India's biggest IPO and a busy results day.

item.title: Jio IPO listing: GMP ₹243 hints at ~22% premium; anchor book 30x subscribed
item.description: Grey-market traders price Jio Platforms near ₹1,362 ahead of its 28 October debut, after anchors bid over ₹2.5 lakh crore. Here is what those signals do and…

item.title: Viral market posts fact-checked: WhatsApp tips, ‘156-year’ crash call, Bitcoin cycle
item.description: The biggest money claims racing across X and WhatsApp this month, and what the data actually says about each one.

item.title: Happy Dussehra: 10 trading lessons from Ravan's 10 heads
item.description: Ravan knew more than almost anyone in the Ramayana. Ego, not ignorance, brought him down, and markets punish the same flaw.

item.title: Stock market today: Sensex sinks 876 pts, Nifty 22,889; PSU banks only gainers
item.description: Private banks and IT led a broad sell-off; midcaps and smallcaps fell over 1% and investors lost about ₹5.5 lakh crore.

item.title: Overnight: US 10-year yield hits 5.14%, Nasdaq +1.1%, rupee at 94.92
item.description: Tech bounced on Wall Street, but rising yields and a firm dollar kept pressure on gold, the yen and emerging markets.

item.title: Gold holds near $4,180; India 24K at ₹1,48,040 per 10g, silver ₹2.3 lakh/kg
item.description: Silver outshines gold as the gold-silver ratio drops below 72; festive buyers face near-record prices.

item.title: Rupee slips to 94.92 per dollar as foreign outflows and oil weigh
item.description: The dollar index firms near 102 while the yen hits 158.5, a sign of broad dollar strength.

item.title: Fed hike bets: ~90% odds of another rate rise this year as yields top 5.1%
item.description: The Fed meets around 28 October; markets expect it to wait until December.

item.title: Results week: Infosys, Kotak, IndusInd, Swiggy among 200+ firms reporting Q2
item.description: Eternal and Adani Green report Wednesday; HPCL and Havells on Thursday; Infosys and Dr Reddy's on Friday.

item.title: Jio Platforms IPO opens Wednesday at ₹1,065–1,119 a share
item.description: A roughly ₹30,000 crore issue runs 21–23 October; Paras Healthcare also lists this week.

item.title: Sensex drops 876 points as Axis Bank and IT drag; markets shut today
item.description: Nifty ends at 22,888.95 after profit-taking snaps a two-day rally.

item.title: Nasdaq bounces 1.1% as tech recovers; Netflix, Tesla, Meta report this week
item.description: Amazon jumps nearly 5% as easing yields and oil help AI and chip stocks.

item.title: Oil stays above $100 as Houthi attacks hit Saudi targets
item.description: Brent near $108 keeps pressure on India's import bill and the rupee.

item.title: SEBI to make brokers show investor warnings in trading apps from 1 November
item.description: A new closing auction session for end-of-day prices is also being finalised.

item.title: Boldfit raises ₹400 crore as Indian startups pull in about $120M in a week
item.description: DailyObjects, Clueso and Mesa School of Business also closed rounds.

item.title: Zetwerk leads a ₹10,500 crore IPO week
item.description: Nine issues hit the market last week, from a ₹5,012 crore Zetwerk offer to small SME listings.

item.title: Anthropic sets aside 5% of its shares for a new Public Benefit Fund
item.description: The stake can grow as the company's valuation climbs, pending shareholder approval.
